title: Jacob Blesses Ephraim and Manasseh

questions.question: Who did Joseph bring to Jacob to be blessed?
options: His two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim
questions.correctAnswer: His two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim
questions.explanation: Genesis 48:1 (ESV): "So he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim."

questions.question: What did Jacob do when he blessed Joseph's sons?
questions.explanation: Genesis 48:14: "Israel stretched out his right hand and laid it on the head of Ephraim, who was the younger, and his left hand on the head of Manasseh, crossing his hands."

questions.question: Which son received the greater blessing?
questions.explanation: Genesis 48:19: "Nevertheless, his younger brother shall be greater than he."

questions.question: Did Joseph try to correct his father's hand placement?
questions.explanation: Genesis 48:17-18: "When Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand on the head of Ephraim, it displeased him, and he took his father's hand to remove it."

questions.question: What did Jacob say about his vision?
options: It was dim due to age
questions.correctAnswer: It was dim due to age
questions.explanation: Genesis 48:10: "Now the eyes of Israel were dim with age, so that he could not see."

questions.question: What status did Jacob give Ephraim and Manasseh?
options: They would be like Reuben and Simeon (his own sons)
questions.correctAnswer: They would be like Reuben and Simeon (his own sons)
questions.explanation: Genesis 48:5: "Ephraim and Manasseh shall be mine; like Reuben and Simeon, they shall be mine."

questions.question: Who did Jacob say had been his shepherd all his life?
questions.explanation: Genesis 48:15: "The God who has been my shepherd all my life long to this day."

questions.question: In whose name did Jacob bless the boys?
questions.explanation: Genesis 48:16: "Let my name be carried on in them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac."

questions.question: What prophecy did Jacob make about the younger brother?
options: His offspring would become a multitude of nations
questions.correctAnswer: His offspring would become a multitude of nations
questions.explanation: Genesis 48:19: "His offspring shall become a multitude of nations."

questions.question: What extra portion did Jacob give to Joseph?
options: A mountain slope (Shechem) taken from the Amorites
questions.correctAnswer: A mountain slope (Shechem) taken from the Amorites
questions.explanation: Genesis 48:22: "I have given to you rather than to your brothers one mountain slope that I took from the hand of the Amorites with my sword and with my bow."

questions.question: Where did Jacob bury Rachel?
questions.explanation: Genesis 48:7: "I buried her there on the way to Ephrath (that is, Bethlehem)."

questions.question: Why did Jacob guide his hands knowingly?
options: Because he knew God's will was to bless the younger over the older
questions.correctAnswer: Because he knew God's will was to bless the younger over the older
questions.explanation: Genesis 48:14, 19: Jacob "crossed his hands" knowingly, and refused Joseph's correction, stating the younger would be greater.

questions.question: What angel did Jacob mention in his blessing?
options: The angel who redeemed him from all evil
questions.correctAnswer: The angel who redeemed him from all evil
questions.explanation: Genesis 48:16: "The angel who has redeemed me from all evil, bless the boys."

questions.question: What specific phrase did Jacob use to describe God's presence with him?
questions.explanation: Genesis 48:3: "God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan and blessed me."

questions.question: How did Jacob strengthen himself when Joseph came?
questions.explanation: Genesis 48:2: "Israel summoned his strength and sat up in bed."

key_verse_text: He blessed Joseph and said, 'The God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked, the God who has been my shepherd all my life long to this day...'
